title: Markov Chain Approximation of Sticky Diffusions and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman Equations on Networks
summary: We propose a discrete Markov-chain approximation of diffusion processes on networks with both Kirchhoff and sticky vertex conditions. Stickiness is modeled by a probabilistic residence mechanism at the vertex, while the motion along the edges follows an Euler-Maruyama-type update at the diffusive scale. We prove that the associated time-interpolated chain converges in distribution to the limiting diffusion in the Skorokhod space using the Ethier-Kurtz framework.
